title: THE BOARDING

floorplan.camera: on the platform at standing height, looking along the sleeper toward the engine

anchors.GRAND HALL: vaulted terminus hall behind the camera, arched glass roof over night sky
anchors.PLATFORM: long lamplit platform running bottom-centre to the engine
anchors.SLEEPER TRAIN: deep-green sleeping cars with brass window trim along the platform's left
anchors.ENGINE: far end of the platform, headlamp glaring through steam
anchors.FOOTBRIDGE: iron footbridge spanning the platform midway, high above

cast.depth: high and far, atop the footbridge at the engine end
cast.action: stands motionless on the footbridge above the platform, the inspector's lantern raised high, the greatcoat hanging heavy and still, its blank face angled down the platform toward the gang
cast.gaze_target: the diamond case at Lucy's feet

cast.depth: midground, perched side-saddle on her stacked trunk
cast.action: sits side-saddle on a stacked brass-bound trunk, legs crossed at the ankle, a leather-bound novel held face-down and unopened in her lap, heavy-lidded gaze level at the footbridge — early for departure, unbothered by ghosts
cast.gaze_target: the Grey Passenger, with utter boredom

cast.depth: foreground frame-left, kneeling at the open diamond case
cast.action: kneels on one knee at the open brass-bound case, a small brass loupe to her eye, documenting the blue-white stone on its velvet bed before it travels

cast.depth: foreground frame-right, between the camera and the train
cast.action: stands between the camera and the train, left arm extended sideways at waist height, palm open — a barrier between the footbridge and the others — masked face tilted up toward the ironwork

cast.depth: low in frame at Wyatt's heels
cast.action: stands rigid at Wyatt's heels, nose lifted high scenting the steam toward the footbridge, ears pricked, tail low and still

props.anchor: PLATFORM: open at Lucy's knee, the blue-white stone on dark velvet
props.description: a small black morocco leather case, open, the Aurora Diamond on black velvet inside, its facets throwing a cold white star

props.anchor: FOOTBRIDGE: raised high in its hand, green shade glowing dim
props.description: a dim green-shaded inspector's lantern, lit

props.anchor: PLATFORM: stacked pair she sits upon, stickers blank
props.description: a brass-bound steamer trunk, lid open on folded blankets, its travel stickers blank and unmarked

props.anchor: PLATFORM: small brass loupe at her eye, documenting the stone

moment: The midnight departure, caught mid-action, everyone in motion. The Grey Passenger watches from the ironwork as the gang boards the green-and-brass sleeper. Wyatt bars its path; Lucy logs the stone; Akane turns a blank page, indifferent.
environment: vaulted trainshed with an arched glass roof on night sky; rows of warm gaslight globes; low steam curling along the boards; porters with trolleys blurred mid-stride; a huge round station clock, its face a blank white disc with black hands only, its face unmarked; deep-green sleeping cars with brass window trim and warm berth windows; open doors with folded steps; pigeons on the girders, shapes only.
lighting: warm gaslight pools along the platform; cold moonlit wash through the roof glass; the engine headlamp glaring from the far end, rimming the greatcoat on the bridge; long shadows down the boards.
colour: full, rich colour — CIWL green, brass gold, warm skin tones; the passenger ash-grey at the top of it all.
negatives: timetables, tickets, the clock face, signs and stickers are plain blank panels of colour
clean costumes, undamaged props and safe set dressing throughout
the passenger reads as a solid costume standing on its own feet, dense opaque cloth
Akane's hands stay busy in her lap or at her sides
hands hold only period props: paper tickets, luggage handles, a hat
Wyatt's hands are clean bare skin, his only tattoos the king and queen on his neck
